2.50.17
Matrix.ZIndex
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Matrix.ZIndex element specifies the ZIndex of a Matrix. This element is optional. If this element
is present, its value MUST be an UnsignedInt. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted
as 0.
Following is the parent element of the Matrix.ZIndex element.
Parent elements
Matrix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Matrix.ZIndex element.
 <xsd:element name="ZIndex" type="xsd:unsignedInt" minOccurs="0" />
